changelog: Fix: backup triggers now report the real reason when the UrBackup API login fails instead of a generic 'unable to login' message. If the UrBackup account has a password but URBACKUP_PASSWORD is unset in St0r's .env, the error now says so explicitly (issue #16)
Fix: login no longer caches an unauthenticated salt session when UrBackup rejects the credentials, which previously caused start_backup to fail silently
Security: resolved all npm audit findings — critical node-tar, high undici/form-data/nodemailer, and moderate react-router advisories (0 vulnerabilities remaining in backend and frontend)
